errors.text_span: und liegt zwischen den Preisen von Bayern und Niedersachsen
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the 'Deutschland' bar (31,911 Euro/ha) lies between the prices of 'Bayern' (76,081 Euro/ha) and 'Niedersachsen' (47,689 Euro/ha). In fact, the value for 'Deutschland' is lower than both of these. Visually in the sorted list, the 'Deutschland' bar is positioned between 'Schleswig-Holstein' (32,570 Euro/ha) and 'Mecklenburg-Vorpommern' (24,784 Euro/ha).
